sentences.en: The teacher used inductive reasoning to explain the concept.
sentences.zh: 老师用归纳的方式来解释这个概念。

sentences.en: He developed his argument in an inductive manner, starting with specific examples.
sentences.zh: 他以归纳的方式发展了他的论点，从具体的例子开始。

sentences.en: The study used inductive methods to analyze the data collected from interviews.
sentences.zh: 这项研究使用归纳的方法来分析从访谈中收集的数据。

senses.zh: [数] 归纳的；[电] 感应的；诱导的
